sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: an open-weight 24B reasoning model with 2B active parameters, built for fast, private on-device agents. Beats Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on LiveClaw.

sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: 24B parameter Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model with 2B active parameters and 131K context, built for fast, private agents on-device ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-24B-A2B is the largest LFM2.5 model, a Mixture-of-Experts model combining 24B total parameters with only 2B active parameters per token and a 131K context window.

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-ONNX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a Mixture of Experts reasoning model with 24B total parameters and 2B active parameters per token, built for fast, private agents on-device. It is the largest model in the LFM2.5 family.
